crossRefs.note: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely…

translations.web: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.
translations.bsb: If you see the donkey of one who hates you fallen under its load, do not leave it there; you must help him with it.
translations.kjv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, and wouldest forbear to help him, thou shalt surely help
translations.asv: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden, thou shalt forbear to leave him, thou shalt surely release it with him.
